nodes.label: Expo SDK 54 / Android API 36 upgrade procedure
nodes.rationale: Records the Android production build after moving apps/mobile to Expo SDK 54 and target API 36. The AAB was not uploaded to Google Play; device validation remains before release. No broad npm audit fix was run.

nodes.label: Expo SDK 54
nodes.rationale: Chosen stable Expo baseline that supports Android API 36. The work did not force an unsupported SDK 52 override and did not jump to a newer SDK. expo prebuild --clean was not run, so the committed native project was not regenerated. Installed Expo resolved to 54.0.37 while the EAS artifact reports SDK 54.0.0. app.json enables reactCompiler and autolinkingModuleResolution. Root package.json overrides that pinned Expo 52, React Native 0.76, and Metro 0.80 were removed.

nodes.label: Expo SDK 52
nodes.rationale: apps/mobile started as an Expo SDK 52 bare app with a committed Android project. Google Play rejected new submissions because that project targeted API 34.

nodes.label: Android API 36
nodes.rationale: Compile and target SDK for the production AAB. Minimum SDK stays 24. Play Console still has to accept target API 36 after upload.

nodes.label: Android API 34
nodes.rationale: Previous target. Google Play rejected new submissions because the app targeted API 34.

nodes.label: React Native 0.81.5
nodes.rationale: React Native version paired with Expo SDK 54. Its C++ build requires NDK 27.0.12077973.

nodes.label: React 19.1.0
nodes.rationale: Mobile resolves React 19.1 for Expo 54, with @types/react 19.1.17. A root-hoisted React 19.2 required by an unrelated backend/Next 16 graph was left alone. expo-doctor passed 16 of 18 checks and that warning was not turned into unrelated work.

nodes.label: New Architecture
nodes.rationale: newArchEnabled stayed true so existing architecture behavior was preserved. SDK 54's New Architecture setup requires react-native-worklets.

nodes.label: react-native-worklets
nodes.rationale: Added at 0.5.1 because SDK 54's New Architecture setup requires it.

nodes.label: Metro
nodes.rationale: SDK 54 has first-class monorepo support, so watchFolders, nodeModulesPaths, and disableHierarchicalLookup were removed from apps/mobile/metro.config.js. The old hierarchical lookup made Metro fail to resolve nested is-arrayish inside simple-swizzle. Existing Stellar and application aliases remain.

nodes.label: expo-node.js
nodes.rationale: SDK 54 first used the repository root for the Android Gradle bundle task, so the app entry resolved from the wrong directory. apps/mobile/scripts/expo-node.js runs Node with EXPO_NO_METRO_WORKSPACE_ROOT=1, and android/app/build.gradle invokes that wrapper so the release bundle stays rooted at apps/mobile.

nodes.label: Android Gradle toolchain
nodes.rationale: compileSdk and targetSdk 36, build tools 36.0.0, Kotlin 2.0.21, NDK 27.0.12077973, and Gradle 8.13. minSdkVersion stays 24. These match Google Play's API 36 requirement and the SDK 54 / React Native 0.81 toolchain. Native settings were applied directly because this bare project does not auto-sync app.json.

nodes.label: EAS
nodes.rationale: Production profile with remote versioning. The first upload failed because a locked file under apps/mobile/android/.gradle was archived; generated Gradle, build, and .cxx folders were then gitignored. Remote auto-increment reserved version code 4 for that failed submission. Do not submit an iOS build as part of this Android release, and avoid a duplicate Android build because it would reserve another version code.

nodes.label: Android App Bundle
nodes.rationale: EAS build 48672c62-9398-499d-b053-b177a1bc441d finished as a production store AAB, marketing version 1.0.0, version code 5, SDK 54.0.0. It has not been uploaded. After fresh-install and upgrade checks on Android 16, upload that exact artifact to Google Play internal testing.

nodes.label: com.anonymous.pijinapp
nodes.rationale: Android package id. Existing EAS owner, signing, app id, version, permissions, and remote versioning were preserved.

nodes.label: Google Play
nodes.rationale: Rejected the previous API 34 target. The completed AAB is intended for Internal testing only after device validation, not a production rollout in this procedure.

nodes.label: RestoreWalletScreen
nodes.source_location: Source correction discovered by type checking
nodes.rationale: Typecheck found a stale import of nonexistent saveDeviceKey in apps/mobile/src/screens/RestoreWalletScreen.tsx. The restore guard now requires exists, stellarPublicKey, and shortId before login so incomplete account state cannot reach login.
